name: APILayer
label: APILayer
description: Fixer official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: fixer_latest, fixer_convert, fixer_historical, fixer_timeseries, fixer_fluctuation, fixer_symbols. Docs: https://fixer.io/documentation. Base https://data.fixer.io/api. Auth is query access_key from configuration. The marketplace gateway https://api.apilayer.com and header apikey are deliberately unused. JSONP callback is deliberately unused. Numverify/Mediastack/marketstack are separate nodes. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One APILayer request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"fixer_latest"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: fixer_latest | fixer_convert | fixer_historical | fixer_timeseries | fixer_fluctuation | fixer_symbols. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'fixer_latest'.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Amount to convert for fixer_convert. Example: 10.5.

schema.label: base
schema.description: Base currency for fixer_latest. Example: USD.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Historical date YYYY-MM-DD for fixer_historical. Example: 2026-01-15.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Source currency for fixer_convert. Example: USD.

schema.label: spread
schema.description: Optional FX spread for convert. Example: 2.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Target currency for fixer_convert. Example: EUR.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: fixer_latest, fixer_convert, fixer_historical, fixer_timeseries, fixer_fluctuation, fixer_symbols.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query` parameter access_key. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
